bank_accounts_primary_user_unique.name: bank_accounts_primary_user_unique
bank_accounts_primary_user_unique.where: "bank_accounts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bank_accounts"."is_primary" = true AND "bank_accounts"."is_active" = true

bank_accounts_primary_station_unique.name: bank_accounts_primary_station_unique
bank_accounts_primary_station_unique.where: "bank_accounts"."station_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bank_accounts"."is_primary" = true AND "bank_accounts"."is_active" = true

bank_accounts_exactly_one_owner.name: bank_accounts_exactly_one_owner
bank_accounts_exactly_one_owner.value: ("bank_accounts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bank_accounts"."station_id" IS NULL) OR ("bank_accounts"."user_id" IS NULL AND "bank_accounts"."station_id" IS NOT NULL)

financial_accounts_ownership_valid.name: financial_accounts_ownership_valid
financial_accounts_ownership_valid.value:
("financial_accounts"."account_type" = 'PLATFORM_CASH' AND "financial_accounts"."user_id" IS NULL AND "financial_accounts"."station_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("financial_accounts"."account_type" = 'USER_AVAILABLE' AND "financial_accounts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "financial_accounts"."station_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("financial_accounts"."account_type" = 'USER_ALLOCATED' AND "financial_accounts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "financial_accounts"."station_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("financial_accounts"."account_type" = 'STATION_PAYABLE' AND "financial_accounts"."user_id" IS NULL AND "financial_accounts"."station_id" IS NOT NULL)

financial_transactions_hold_account_pres.name: financial_transactions_hold_account_presence
financial_transactions_hold_account_pres.value: ("financial_transactions"."hold_amount" = 0 AND "financial_transactions"."hold_account_id" IS NULL) OR ("financial_transactions"."hold_amount" > 0 AND "financial_transactions"."hold_account_id" IS NOT NULL)

financial_transactions_hold_backed_types.name: financial_transactions_hold_backed_types
financial_transactions_hold_backed_types.value:
("financial_transactions"."transaction_type" IN ('FUEL_PURCHASE', 'WITHDRAWAL', 'SETTLEMENT')
          AND "financial_transactions"."hold_amount" = "financial_transactions"."requested_amount"
          AND "financial_transactions"."hold_account_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("financial_transactions"."transaction_type" NOT IN ('FUEL_PURCHASE', 'WITHDRAWAL', 'SETTLEMENT')
          AND "financial_transactions"."hold_amount" = 0
          AND "financial_transactions"."hold_account_id" IS NULL)

financial_transactions_actual_amount_wit.name: financial_transactions_actual_amount_within_request
financial_transactions_actual_amount_wit.value: "financial_transactions"."transaction_type" NOT IN ('FUEL_PURCHASE', 'WITHDRAWAL', 'SETTLEMENT') OR "financial_transactions"."amount" IS NULL OR "financial_transactions"."amount" <= "financial_transactions"."requested_amount"

financial_transactions_completed_outgoin.name: financial_transactions_completed_outgoing_full_capture
financial_transactions_completed_outgoin.value: "financial_transactions"."transaction_type" NOT IN ('WITHDRAWAL', 'SETTLEMENT') OR "financial_transactions"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' OR ("financial_transactions"."amount" = "financial_transactions"."requested_amount" AND "financial_transactions"."captured_amount" = "financial_transactions"."requested_amount" AND "financial_transactions"."released_amount" = 0)

financial_transactions_required_referenc.name: financial_transactions_required_references
financial_transactions_required_referenc.value:
("financial_transactions"."transaction_type" = 'TOP_UP' AND "financial_transactions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "financial_transactions"."bank_account_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("financial_transactions"."transaction_type" = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND "financial_transactions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "financial_transactions"."bank_account_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("financial_transactions"."transaction_type" = 'ALLOCATION' AND "financial_transactions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "financial_transactions"."station_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("financial_transactions"."transaction_type" = 'DEALLOCATION' AND "financial_transactions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "financial_transactions"."station_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("financial_transactions"."transaction_type" = 'TRANSFER' AND "financial_transactions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "financial_transactions"."source_station_id" IS NOT NULL AND "financial_transactions"."destination_station_id" IS NOT NULL AND "financial_transactions"."source_station_id" <> "financial_transactions"."destination_station_id")
        OR ("financial_transactions"."transaction_type" = 'FUEL_PURCHASE' AND "financial_transactions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "financial_transactions"."station_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("financial_transactions"."transaction_type" = 'SETTLEMENT' AND "financial_transactions"."station_id" IS NOT NULL AND "financial_transactions"."bank_account_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("financial_transactions"."transaction_type" = 'REVERSAL' AND "financial_transactions"."reversal_of_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL)

financial_transactions_reversal_referenc.name: financial_transactions_reversal_reference_only_for_reversals
financial_transactions_reversal_referenc.value: ("financial_transactions"."transaction_type" = 'REVERSAL' AND "financial_transactions"."reversal_of_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("financial_transactions"."transaction_type" <> 'REVERSAL' AND "financial_transactions"."reversal_of_transaction_id" IS NULL)
